detailed_descriptions.en: The community has spoken, and we have answered. By popular demand, we present the fourth collection of vanity items for Grim Dawn. This time, we channeled our grim energy into 4 macabre sets and matching weapons, 26 illusions in all. Whether you are just joining us or have been a fan for years, we guarantee these cosmetic items will help you look your grimmest while conquering Grim Dawn's foulest enemies. The items in this DLC can be applied to existing gear to transform the look while retaining the original stats. They do not provide any gameplay stats or bonuses on their own. Become the nightmare the nightmares you face are afraid of! Loyalist Item Pack 4 items can be claimed in-game from the NPC "Lancel the Knight" who stands outside the gates of Devil's Crossing, by selecting the “I wish to tap into the divine” dialogue option. Note that this illusion pack requires version v1.3.1.0 or higher. For owners of the Ashes of Malmouth DLC, the items you receive from Lancel are added to your Illusionist collection rather than being applied directly to items. a ghastly Dark Priest conjuring a deadly barrage of dread magic with a crossbow the wicked Plague Doctor and his cruel injector a chilling Keeper of the Dead shepherding the souls of the damned with its off-hand staff a Vampiric Knight armed with a bloodthirsty greatsword

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The community has spoken, and we have answered. By popular demand, we present the fourth collection of vanity items for Grim Dawn. This time, we channeled our grim energy into 4 macabre sets and matching weapons, 26 illusions in all. Whether you are just joining us or have been a fan for years, we guarantee these cosmetic items will help you look your grimmest while conquering Grim Dawn's foulest enemies.

The items in this DLC can be applied to existing gear to transform the look while retaining the original stats. They do not provide any gameplay stats or bonuses on their own.

Become the nightmare the nightmares you face are afraid of!

Loyalist Item Pack 4 items can be claimed in-game from the NPC "Lancel the Knight" who stands outside the gates of Devil's Crossing, by selecting the “I wish to tap into the divine” dialogue option.

Note that this illusion pack requires version v1.3.1.0 or higher. For owners of the Ashes of Malmouth DLC, the items you receive from Lancel are added to your Illusionist collection rather than being applied directly to items.

  • a ghastly Dark Priest conjuring a deadly barrage of dread magic with a crossbow

  • the wicked Plague Doctor and his cruel injector

  • a chilling Keeper of the Dead shepherding the souls of the damned with its off-hand staff

  • a Vampiric Knight armed with a bloodthirsty greatsword
